confidence_notes: Medium overall. Food and drink anchors triangulate several Cartagena cost-of-living summaries and venue listings of mixed date and quality. Aggregated figures conflict for the mid-range two-person meal, so that anchor is a bounded central estimate. Cocktail rests on several listings. Wine_glass rests on thin direct data (one listing and one menu) and was cross-checked against the local wine-to-beer relationship (about 3.5 times the beer anchor). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not searched or checked against live listings; July mid-year holiday demand and taxes may push them up. Local sources disagree on the COP/USD rate, so USD food and drink values carry FX uncertainty. The fx value is the 18 Nov 2026 RBA observation found in search; a 19 Nov fixing may already be published.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors follow Cartagena-specific aggregated summaries and tourist-district venue listings. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of Colombian Caribbean-coast tourist lodging rather than a named comparable city.
